integrity: An all-parameter integral Mayer–Vietoris proof is given. A separate standard-library program corroborates stages and permutation actions for five finite parameter pairs over fields of characteristics 2, 3 and 5. This does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The integral S_a by S_b extension class at stage two is specified by a natural short exact sequence, not asserted to split. Only side-preserving graph symmetries and complete bipartite graphs with both sides of size at least two are covered. The underlying stagewise homotopy types were already established in Carnero Bravo, Theorem 33. Independent mathematical assessment has not been performed.
title: Symmetry layers and surviving classes in complete-bipartite forest filtrations
